2ndxi.message: Can someone please bring the first aid kit over from the changing room
2ndxi.author: Keita Elliott

2ndxi.message: Hey team, you guys have early release for 2.30pm. Will and I will be driving the vans, please be outside the small gym at 2.35pm.
2ndxi.author: Keita Elliott

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, hope you have all had a good week!

Just trying to get a gauge as to numbers around transport tomorrow. Please respond to this poll if you are available for the game if you will need a van or not going to the game. The van will come back to college once the first 11 game has finished. 

Cheers, 
Will Litchfield
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: We have found a ref!
2ndxi.author: Keita Elliott

2ndxi.message: Morning team, our ref for today has just become unavailable! Do we have any parents that could ref?
2ndxi.author: Keita Elliott

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Game tomorrow is at home vs MAGS, will be a wet pitch so if you have metal stud boots please bring them. 

Be there 9am for a 10am K.O. 

Cheers, let’s get another win 💪💯
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
What a performance today lads, 4 goals, clean sheet and controlled the game incredibly well. Congratulations! 

Enjoy your weekends, parents thank you for all your support! See you all next week at training 👏
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

Game info tomorrow, meet at selwyn changing rooms at 9:00am for a 10:00am ko. 

Huge game against Howick tomorrow, let’s give them a big fight and come away with the win 💪
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Because it suits most people, we will do a 2:30pm-3:45 training tomorrow.

See you all then.
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

With exams this week, I’m aware the latest exam finishes at 2pm? (Correct me if I’m wrong), would you guys want to do a 2:30pm training time start instead to make it easier for everyone? 

Thumbs up to this message if so!
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys just letting you know that I’ve decided to leave 2nd XI, good luck for the rest of the season

Thanks
2ndxi.author: Max J

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Does anyone have a pair of GK gloves they are able to bring to the game tomorrow? If you can, please let me know in the replies section to this message as soon as possible. 

Thanks!!
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: 2-0 Auckland FC thus far...;)
2ndxi.author: Jarrod King

2ndxi.message: For tomorrow’s game, can we confirmation on the timings please? TeamReach says 11.30am start but collegesport.co.nz says 10am 🤷🏻‍♂
2ndxi.author: Brian Lomas

2ndxi.message:
Hey everyone, 

Just some clarification around tomorrow’s game…

Meet at 9am at selwyn for a 10am ko. 

Let’s get our first three points tomorrow 💪
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: Back field today lads
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, 

Hope you have all recovered well after the weekend. 

This week Mr Box will be recording some videos for his C licence with us, so if you could all update TeamReach as soon as possible, so he can plan the session, that would be greatly appreciated!

See you all on Thursday.
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: Could anyone please drop off Marvin and kase home after the game?
2ndxi.author: jo gosse

2ndxi.message:
Hey guys, game tomorrow is at St Kent’s away, field 1. 

Ko is 10am so try to be there for 9am to give us enough time to warm up + get ready before the game!

If you are not feeling 100% or are injured and cannot commit to a full game, personally I’d rather you rest up for next week than risk re-injury or prolonged sickness. We have plenty of players so please let me know if you aren’t going to make it. 

Cheers, hopefully we can grab our first 3 points of the year tomorrow!
2ndxi.author: Will Litchfield

2ndxi.message: I’ve just injured my calve in pe and I won’t be able to attend training I will see if I’m okay for the game

13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message:
Hey everyone, 
Just a quick message about footballs. We have lost about a dozen balls this season already and we won’t be buying any more. 
Can you please make sure that when you use the bags of balls, the same number of balls are in the bag at the end of training. If you combine 2 bags, can you please make sure that the correct balls are put back in the correct bags. There should be 8 balls in most bags. If you lose any or they go over a fence just let us know so we can try to get them back. 
Thanks! 😊
13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message:
Morning team! 

We have a few sickness/injuries this week. 

Pedro and Harry are injured and Carter is unwell so those will be our stand downs this week. 

This means Michael and Liam M will be in the team for this week. 

I will adjust the stand down rotation and send out an updated version next week :)
13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message: Thanks Keita. Not sure how bad it is at the moment. He’s got to go to get a scan to find out what the damage is. He’s gutted.
13a.author: Nick Mackeson-Smith

13a.message: Oh no that’s no good! Hopefully nothing serious? Yep will have a look who’s rotated out, and send out a message and email tomorrow! Don’t feel pressured to come on Saturday as I will be there so if you change your mind let me know 😊
13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message:
Hiya. Harry has been at A&E today. He’s damaged his knee in ultimate frisbee in PE at school today and has been told to sit out football this weekend. 

We’ll still come along and I’ll help with subs and Harry will be there to support the team, but letting you know so you can plan for the team selection. Perhaps one of the boys rotating out can come in this weekend and swap with Harry’s out weekend later in the term? 

Let me know what you need. 
Cheers
13a.author: Nick Mackeson-Smith

13a.message: I wont be coming today due to my sickness
13a.author: Henry An

13a.message:
Well done to all today! Match report from a remarkable game. Fantastic second half performance to turn it around. 

Hope everyone is now warm and dry. Enjoy the rest of the weekend.
13a.author: Nick Mackeson-Smith

13a.message:
Hi everyone. I just want to thank you to the boys who played today. I'm so proud of the energy and passion that you showed today - especially towards the end of the game. 

To those who scored, I believe it was; Harry, Rio, and Finn who got 2. Very well done. Not to mention the assister's and the backline who played very well!

Also thank you so much to Moji, for coaching in the pouring rain, and making the journey to Takapuna. Also thank you so much to all the parents who got up early to drive us to the game, stood there in the pouring rain, and of course will have to deal with all the muddy clothes.

Thanks again,
Jake

P.S, does anyone happen to have filmed the penalty?.....
